**Issue #4286 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4286: Patch: the reply's countdown blend is screened and set where the screen keeps it
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When the practice opponent weighs its options on a turn where a delayed effect is still ticking down (the public "in N turns" badges), it scores each option twice: once as the board stands, and once with every countdown fired at its next turn start. It then blends the two scores with a fixed guess of half weight per turn waited. That guess was never measured. It was a starting value left for the training program to tune, and the training program no longer runs. Once built, the computer's valuation of every line that leaves a countdown ticking rests on a measured number instead of a guess. Players notice it as a practice opponent that handles countdown cards more sensibly, neither throwing away setup plays nor overpaying for futures that never arrive.

## Why

- `AI_REPLY.countdown_share` is `0.5` in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, commented `#1995: untuned; the training lanes may move it`.
- `training/README.md`: the `improve` and `unban` lanes are stopped (#1677) and the `learn` lane is retired (#4159, R4159000). No lane remains to move it, so the guess sits forever unless an ordinary issue screens it.
- The blend steers real decisions: `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` (`countdowns_due`, R1181000) scores every line with a waiting countdown a second time, fired, and blends at `share^wait`, so a wrong share systematically misevaluates all such lines.
- Nothing open or rejected covers it: #4246 is the reply's other blend switch (`open_lethal`), #4257 is the Cleave splash beside a GIGA, and the rejected list holds no countdown item.

## Proposal

- Screen candidate values (`0`, `0.25`, `0.5`, `0.75`, `1.0`) with `cargo jackioh arena --a self --b bin:<control> --set improve-dev`, following `training/improve.md` ("A screen"): 400 paired games per screen, control built from the committed tip.
- Set `countdown_share` to the screened winner when its edge over the `0.5` control holds up (paired edge interval clear of zero); otherwise keep `0.5` and record the screen in the constant's comment.
- Rewrite the constant's comment to name the screen (games, edge, interval) instead of "untuned".
- No ruling note: this tunes a named constant, not a rules decision, so the spec is unchanged.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/config.rs` (`AI_REPLY.countdown_share`); SPEC §9.9 (practice AI) and R1181000 (countdown badges).
- `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` stays as it is (the blend arithmetic is unchanged); the screen method lives in `training/improve.md` ("A screen") and `crates/tools/src/arena.rs` (`--set improve-dev`).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Screen table posted: each candidate's wins, paired edge and 95% interval against the `0.5` control on `improve-dev`.
- [ ] `countdown_share` set to the screened value with the screen named in its comment, or kept at `0.5` with the no-keep screen recorded there.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` green, countdown tests (`tests/ai/slumber.rs`, `tests/ai/meditative_plus.rs`) included.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` smoke green.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.

## Size and risks

- Medium work, `difficulty:hard` (the AI, per `docs/issues-and-patches.md`), `priority:low` (class `ai`). One constant plus screens of about 30 to 45 minutes each; run candidates in order and stop early on a clear winner.
- Risk: screen noise picks a false winner. Mitigated by paired deals and by requiring the interval to clear zero, else `0.5` stays.
- Risk: none to the rules. Value change only; countdown logic and every signature are untouched.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44673509894)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Screen `AI_REPLY.countdown_share` (currently the untuned `0.5` guess in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`) against the `0.5` control on the improve-dev seed set, then set it to the screened winner when its paired edge interval clears zero, else keep `0.5`. Rewrite the constant's comment to name the screen (games, edge, interval) instead of "untuned". The blend arithmetic in `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` is unchanged, and no spec or ruling changes: this tunes a named constant, not a rules decision.

## Files to touch

| Path | New / change | What changes there |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | `AI_REPLY.countdown_share` value (line ~1025) and its comment (line ~1024): screened value plus screen citation in the style of the `open_lethal` / `defense_switches` comments |
| Screen table | no file | Recorded in the constant's comment and the pull request body (wins, paired edge, 95% interval per candidate); no new source, test, or spec file |

Must not touch: `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` (`reply_score`, `countdowns_due` arithmetic stays as-is), `crates/engine/`, `crates/cards/`, `crates/server/`, `crates/tools/`, `apps/`, `spec/` and `spec/rulings/`, `spec/pending/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, any migration. Governing spec: §9.9 (practice AI; countdown blended via `AI_REPLY.countdown_share`) and R1181000 (in-N-turns countdown badges). Out of scope: #4246 (`AI_REPLY.open_lethal`) and #4257 (Cleave splash beside a GIGA).

## Steps

1. Confirm the base. In this worktree (`bot/issue-4286`, base `d70de4be`), run `git status --porcelain` (must be clean) and `git rev-parse --short HEAD`; record the control SHA for the comment. Read `crates/ai/src/config.rs` lines 971–1026 and `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` lines 838–920; do not edit `reply.rs`.
2. Build the control from the committed tip, per `training/improve.md` ("A screen"): `cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools && cp target/release/jackioh ~/control-jackioh`. Rebuild it only if the tip moves; the control measures the `0.5` AI without the change.
3. Screen candidate `0`: in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, set `AI_REPLY.countdown_share` to `0.0` (value only, comment later), rebuild (`cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools`), then run `cargo jackioh arena --a self --b bin:~/control-jackioh --set improve-dev` (400 paired games, ~30–45 min). Record from the closing tally: wins–losses, paired `edge` with `edgeLow`–`edgeHigh`, `deals`. Do not extend or re-run the screen.
4. Repeat step 3 for `0.25`, then `0.75`, then `1.0`, each as its own edit–rebuild–arena run against the same `~/control-jackioh`. Run in this order and stop early on a clear winner only to save time (a plainly losing arm is reverted, never kept early).
5. Decide: the winner is the candidate with the largest `edge` whose `edgeLow` is above 0. If none clears zero, keep `0.5`. If several clear zero, take the largest edge; never keep the best of several arms that only read best by noise (each kept arm needs its own `edgeLow > 0`).
6. Apply the decision in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`: set `countdown_share` to the winner (or leave `0.5`). Replace the `// #1995: untuned; the training lanes may move it.` comment with a screened note copying the `open_lethal` pattern, e.g. `// #1995: <value>. Its screen read <W>-<L>, edge <edge> (<edgeLow> to <edgeHigh>) on 400 games on improve-dev vs control <sha> (training/improve.md, A screen).` For a keep, write `// #1995: 0.5 kept. Its screens read … (best <W>-<L>, edge … (…) …), none clearing zero …`. Update the struct-field doc (lines ~1002–1005) only if it still says untuned.
7. Verify: run the AI countdown tests, then the crate suite, then the smoke gate, fmt, and clippy (exact commands in Tests). If any test fails, fix the change (value/comment only), never weaken a test or add an allow.

## Tests

No new tests: the header of `crates/ai/src/config.rs` states tests pin rankings and puzzle outcomes, never these values, and the blend arithmetic is untouched. These existing tests guard the countdown behavior and must pass as part of the suite:

- `crates/ai/tests/ai/meditative_plus.rs`: `the_ai_casts_supply_drop_in_combat_mode_against_three_3_health_units` (Supply Drop countdown weighed past the reply), `r3696000_r4159000_beside_two_castable_vanillas_the_hand_eval_plays_a_vanilla_first`, `r3696000_on_a_tight_budget_the_supply_drop_line_costs_no_world_its_score`, `r3696000_past_the_wrap_up_the_supply_drop_line_is_not_replied_to`.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs`: `r2380000_an_own_dormant_card_scores_above_an_empty_zone_and_an_enemy_one_below_it`, `r2380000_fewer_turns_left_is_worth_more` (Dormant countdown pricing; adjacent to delayed-effect scoring).
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/reply.rs` (`mod reply_score`): the `reply_score` unit tests around lines 281–580.

Commands:

- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai meditative_plus`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai slumber`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai reply`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` (whole crate green)
- `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke size green)
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`

## Done when

- [ ] Screen table recorded (each of `0`, `0.25`, `0.75`, `1.0` vs the `0.5` control: wins, paired edge, 95% interval on `improve-dev`).
- [ ] `countdown_share` set to the screened winner, or kept at `0.5` with the no-keep screen recorded in its comment; comment names games, edge, and interval, not "untuned".
- [ ] Crate suite green, countdown tests included.
- [ ] Gate smoke green; rustfmt and clippy clean.
- [ ] `reply.rs`, spec, and rulings untouched; no new ruling note; no forbidden paths changed.

## Risks

- Screen noise picks a false winner: mitigated by paired deals with seats swapped and by keeping a value only when its `edgeLow` is above 0, else `0.5` stays.
- Gate smoke is a small fixed-seed sample that catches a broken AI, not a lost point or two: do not chase its noise or re-run screens to get a better read.
- Value-only change: countdown logic, signatures, determinism, hidden-information handling (reply reads only public badges), and crate purity are untouched; the only behavioral shift is the intended re-weighting of lines that leave a countdown ticking.

## Open questions

None. Every choice the task leaves open is settled above (candidates, 400 paired games per screen on `improve-dev`, keep rule `edgeLow > 0`, comment style after `open_lethal`/`defense_switches`).
```
